title: Sensex Crash on 19th March 2026 Live: Sensex tanks 1,800 points, Nifty 50 slips below 23,300;  ₹7 lakh crore wiped out | Stock Market News
summary: The Indian stock market experienced a significant crash on March 19, 2026, with the Sensex dropping 1,953.21 points and the Nifty 50 falling below 23,300 due to surging crude oil prices, hawkish US Federal Reserve commentary, and other factors such as HDFC Bank's share price decline and sustained foreign institutional investor selling.
sentiment_reason: The market impact is driven by inflation concerns due to the US Fed's stance, soaring oil prices affecting global markets and energy costs, HDFC Bank's leadership crisis, and consistent foreign selling pressure.
